name: openai-proxy
description: Use your ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription as an OpenAI-compatible API via a local Rust proxy. Bridges any OpenAI Chat Completions client to the Codex Responses API with MCP server support for direct agent integration.

interface.shortDescription: Use your ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription as an OpenAI-compatible API
interface.longDescription: Bridges any OpenAI Chat Completions client to the ChatGPT Codex Responses API, the OpenAI Responses API, or the OpenAI Chat Completions API, with an MCP server for direct agent integration.
